```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = TRUE)

library(tidyverse)
library(MASS)
library(pROC)
library(yardstick)
library(glmnet)
library(rpart)
```

# Intro

```{r}
rm(list=ls())
K <- 10

fscore <- function(true, pred){
  pred <- ifelse(pred > 0.3, 1, 0)
  MLmetrics::F1_Score(as.factor(true), pred, positive="1")
}
```

# k=1

```{r k1}
load("../Dataset_ausiliari/dat_smoothed_scaled_k1.Rdata")
m0 <- glm(goal_YN~., family=binomial, data=dat_smoothed)
library(boot)
cv.glm(data=dat_smoothed, glmfit=m0,
       cost=fscore, K=K)$delta
rm(dat_smoothed)
```
